summary: 慢食运动把享受地方食物与保护濒危品种联系起来。“味觉方舟”登记濒危食物，再为生产者开拓市场，让易洛魁白玉米和传统火鸡等品种能继续在农场生长繁衍。
logic: 从反对快餐到保护地方食物
以白玉米说明销售如何维持种植
用传统火鸡认购增加养殖量
把食用乐趣与多样性联系起来

paragraphs.brief: 慢食开始于意大利记者Carlo Petrini对罗马著名的西班牙广场开一家快餐餐厅感到沮丧。
sentences: Slow Food began when Carlo Petrini, an Italian journalist, was dismayed by the opening of a fast food restaurant on the famous Piazza di Spagna in Rome.
慢食开始于意大利记者Carlo Petrini对罗马著名的西班牙广场开一家快餐餐厅感到沮丧。
He decided it was time to celebrate the fast-disappearing virtues of the slow production, preparation and eating of food.
他决定是时候庆祝食品生产、准备和吃慢而迅速消失的美德了。
What he had in mind when he began the Slow Food organization were local foods which were prepared in their traditional manner and eaten at leisurely meals with family and friends.
他成立慢食组织时所想到的是当地食物，这些食物是按传统方式准备的，在与家人和朋友的闲食中吃。

Slow Food is the antithesis of everything fast food stands for, and it is now a thriving international organization with members in 45 countries, a successful publishing operation and a biannual trade show.
慢食是快速食品所代表一切的对立面，它现在是一个繁荣的国际组织，其成员遍布45个国家，一个成功的出版业务和一个半年一次的贸易展。
In addition, Slow Food has launched a project called the ‘Ark of Taste’ and a concept called ‘virtuous globalization’.
此外，慢粮公司还发起了一个名为 " 塔斯特之舟 " 的项目和一个名为 " 良性全球化 " 的概念。

paragraphs.brief: 塔斯特方舟是濒危食物植物和动物物种的目录，慢食决定保护这些植物和动物免受全球快速食物潮的冲击。
sentences: The Ark of Taste is the catalog of endangered food plant and animal species that Slow Food has resolved to protect against the rising global tide of fast food.
塔斯特方舟是濒危食物植物和动物物种的目录，慢食决定保护这些植物和动物免受全球快速食物潮的冲击。
Some examples of the biodiversity promoted by the Ark of Taste include Iroquois white corn and the Narragansett turkey, both of which are old, or heritage, foods in North America.
塔斯特方舟提倡的生物多样性的一些例子包括伊罗夸斯白玉米和纳拉甘塞特火鸡，两者都是北美的古老或传统食品。

Biodiversity is a term commonly associated with discussions of threats to wild species, but according to Slow Food the biodiversity of the domesticated species people have depended on for centuries is no less important.
生物多样性是一个通常与讨论对野生物种的威胁有关的术语，但根据慢食的说法，几个世纪以来，被养殖的物种的生物多样性也同样重要。

For example, when the latest patented hybrid variety of plant proves unable to withstand fungal or bacterial disease, plant breeders will need the disease-resistant genes which can be obtained from heritage plant varieties.
例如，当最新的专利混合品种植物证明无法抵御真菌病或细菌病时，植物育种者将需要从遗产植物品种中获取的抗病基因。

If Iroquois white corn had fallen out of production, as it very nearly did two decades ago due to the commercial launch of a new hybrid corn, irreplaceable and possibly crucial sets of corn genes would have been lost forever.
如果伊罗柯伊斯的白玉米已经停止生产，就像20年前它几乎停止生产一样，因为商业上推出了一种新的杂交玉米，那么不可替代的、可能至关重要的玉米基因将永远消失。

paragraphs.brief: 一段时间以来，植物保护团体一直在保护遗产植物的品种，但慢粮公司将这一项目推向更进一步。
sentences: For some time, plant-saver groups have been preserving heritage plant varieties, but Slow Food takes that project a step further.
一段时间以来，植物保护团体一直在保护遗产植物的品种，但慢粮公司将这一项目推向更进一步。

The movement understands that all the food and plant species in its Ark of Taste carry not only information about genetic traits but they also embody a set of social practices, and in some cases even a way of life of previous generations.
该运动了解到，其塔斯特方舟中的所有食物和植物物种不仅含有基因特征的信息，而且还体现了一系列社会做法，在某些情况下甚至体现了前几代人的生活方式。

Slow Food teaches that when a variety of food or breed of animal disappears, something greater also disappears: a specific, irreplaceable mode of life that a particular people have devised for living in a particular part of the Earth.
慢食教人，当各种食物或动物品种消失时，一些更大的事物也消失：一种特定的人为生活在地球上某一特定地区而设计的一种不可替代的具体生活模式。
An example of this is the Iroquois white corn.
这方面的一个例子是伊罗魁白玉米。

By working to find new markets for this ancient variety of corn, Slow Food is ensuring a source of income for the Native Americans who grow, roast, and grind this corn and, at the same time, helping to preserve the specific cookery and religious uses that the corn has been selected to support over hundreds of years.
通过努力寻找这些古老的玉米品种的新市场，慢食确保了原住民的收入来源，他们种植、烤和研磨玉米，同时帮助保存玉米在数百年的时间里所选择的特殊烹饪和宗教用途。

paragraphs.brief: 慢食已经远离传统地点来保护稀有动植物物种
sentences: Slow Food has moved away from the traditional locations for preserving rare animal and plant species.
慢食已经远离传统地点来保护稀有动植物物种
For example, instead of zoos for rare animals and botanic gardens for rare plants, Slow Food maintains that its plants and animals are best preserved on the dishes and plates of discerning customers.
例如，慢食公司不是为稀有动物建立动物园，而是为稀有植物建立植物园，它坚持认为，其植物和动物最好保存在辨别顾客的盘子和盘子上。

To this end, Slow Food has introduced the concept of virtuous globalization, which recognizes that the best way to ensure a safe future for distinctive local products and practices is to find a global market for them.
为此，慢粮引入了良性全球化概念，承认确保独特的当地产品和做法有一个安全未来的最佳途径是为它们找到一个全球市场。
In this way, local producers will be able to continue producing the food which for many years has been a defining factor of their cultural identity.
这样，当地生产者将能够继续生产多年来一直是其文化特性决定性因素的粮食。
The characteristics of the virtuous globalization of Slow Foods show how different the concept is from the globalization of fast foods.
慢食的良性全球化的特点表明，这一概念与快食的全球化不同。
Whereas global fast food companies aim to sell food that has an unchanging taste wherever in the world it is eaten, the taste of a recognized Slow Food is unique to that food.
虽然全球快餐公司的目标是销售世界上任何地方的口味不变的食品，但一种公认的慢食的口味是这种食品独有的。
Another aspect is the quantities sold of these two types of food.
另一个方面是这两种食品的销售量。
In the case of fast food, these are enormous, but the quantities of Slow Food products which are available for selling are limited, due to the rarity of the plants or animals.
就快餐而言，这些是巨大的，但由于植物或动物很少，可供销售的慢食产品数量有限。
The customers of virtuous globalization Slow Foods are affluent people who value novelty and are undeterred by the costs, which are high when compared to fast food.
良性全球化的客户是富人，他们重视新奇事物，不受成本的影响，与快餐相比，成本很高。

paragraphs.brief: 几年前，美国的一个农民网络自愿参加了一个全国慢食项目。
sentences: Some years ago, a network of farmers in the USA volunteered to take part in a national Slow Food project.
几年前，美国的一个农民网络自愿参加了一个全国慢食项目。
The project was for the farmers to raise a total of 5,000 turkeys from eggs which had been selected from four varieties of endangered turkey.
该项目旨在从四种危险类型中选出的蛋中养育总共5000只。
The farmers had to begin by hatching the eggs they had been supplied with, then raising the young turkeys to adults.
农民必须首先孵化所供应的鸡蛋，然后将幼火鸡喂成人。
They were promised a guaranteed price per pound for the adult turkeys.
他们被承诺保证以每磅的价格成人火鸡。
The object of the enterprise was to raise heritage turkeys for the North American holiday of Thanksgiving.
企业的目标是在北美感恩节养活传统火鸡。

Although chefs in some restaurants where the turkeys were on the menu complained that the Slow Food turkeys were smaller than industrially produced turkeys, the distinctive flavors were very well received by consumers.
虽然有些餐厅的厨师在菜单上标有火鸡，他们抱怨慢食火鸡比工业生产的火鸡小，但消费者对特制的火鸡口味非常好。
By the following year, the world population of these turkeys had nearly doubled.
到下一年，这些火鸡的世界人口几乎翻了一番。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，快乐是缓慢食品计划带来的回报的一部分，因为它表明，至少在涉及食品政治时，最好的选择往往是提供最舒适的。
sentences: It may seem strange that taking pleasure in eating could be a strategy for preserving biodiversity because pleasure is not normally associated with environmentalism.
也许似乎奇怪的是，在饮食中取乐可能是保护生物多样性的一种战略，因为取乐通常与环境主义无关。

However, pleasure is part of what Slow Food aims to bring back, by demonstrating that, at least when it comes to the politics of food, the best choice is often the one that provides the most enjoyment.
然而，快乐是缓慢食品计划带来的回报的一部分，因为它表明，至少在涉及食品政治时，最好的选择往往是提供最舒适的。

items.en: The Ark of Taste lists food plant and animal species in danger of extinction.
items.zh: 塔斯特方舟列出了濒临灭绝的植物和动物物种。
items.why: “味觉方舟”就是慢食组织拟保护的濒危食用动植物名录。

items.en: Slow Food considers that the term ‘biodiversity’ should be restricted to wild species.
items.zh: 慢食认为，" 生物多样性 " 一词应限于野生物种。
items.why: 慢食组织也看重人类驯化物种的多样性，因此不同意把生物多样性限于野生物种。

items.en: The genes of heritage plants may be of vital importance to modern plant breeders.
items.zh: 遗产植物的基因可能对现代植物育种者至关重要。
items.why: 现代杂交品种遇到病害时，育种者可能需要传统品种携带的抗病基因。

items.en: Countries can sell the genes of their heritage plant varieties internationally.
items.zh: 各国可以在国际上出售其遗产植物品种的基因。
items.why: 文章讲传统品种基因可用于抗病育种，没有交代各国能否跨境出售这些基因。

items.en: Slow Food maintains that food and culture exist independently of each other.
items.zh: 慢食认为，食物和文化是相互独立的。
items.why: 慢食组织认为食物承载社会习俗和生活方式，说明食物与文化密切相联。

items.en: Some Native Americans are now giving cookery classes featuring Iroquois white corn.
items.zh: 一些美国原住民现在提供以伊罗魁白玉米为特色的烹饪课程。
items.why: 原文只说“种、烤、磨”“保留烹饪与宗教用途”,没有提到“开设课程/授课”。题干信息超出文本，判 NG。
表格问慢食的口味。原文用 unique to that food 描述每种慢食各自独有的味道。
慢食所用动植物较稀少，所以可供出售的数量有限。题目要填描述数量的 limited。
无论在哪个国家，全球快餐公司的产品都力求口味不变，原文直接使用 unchanging。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

items.en: What were farmers in the USA given so that they could raise endangered turkeys?
items.zh: 美国的农民给了他们什么来养活濒危的火鸡？
items.why: 直接给出被动结构“supplied with eggs”,对应问句。注意题型允许 ONE WORD,用复数形式与原文一致更自然。

items.en: How many varieties of endangered turkey benefited from the project?
items.zh: 有多少种濒危火鸡从该项目中受益？
items.why: 数字信息直接明示。题型允许数字或拼写。

items.en: Who was not happy with the size of the turkeys?
items.zh: 谁对火鸡的大小不满意？
items.why: 主语即“chefs”,抱怨体型偏小。可写“chefs” BY “restaurant chefs”。

items.en: Who liked the taste of the endangered turkeys?
items.zh: 谁喜欢濒危火鸡的味道？
items.why: 回到对应内容“虽然有些餐厅的厨师在菜单上标有火鸡，他们抱怨慢食火鸡比工业生产的火鸡小，但消费者对特制的火鸡口味非常好”，再按题干要求写出答案。

groups.label: 简答题
groups.instructionsZh: 根据原文简答。每题填一个词，可含数字。

pairs: 原文用一个形容词概括题干中的“面临灭绝危险”。
of vital importance to modern plant breeders
plant breeders will need the disease-resistant genes
原文举出育种者需要抗病基因这一具体用途，说明老品种的基因为何可能至关重要。
第 1 段 · 第 5 句
第 2 段 · 第 3 句
points: 慢食组织认为食物承载社会习俗和生活方式，说明食物与文化密切相联。
表格问慢食的口味。原文用 unique to that food 描述每种慢食各自独有的味道。
clauses: What he had in mind when he began the Slow Food organization were local foods ….
“which were prepared in their traditional manner and eaten at leisurely meals with family and friends”修饰前面的 foods。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 foods，再把修饰信息接回主句。
… due to the commercial launch of a new hybrid corn, irreplaceable and possibly crucial sets of corn genes would have been lost forever.
连接词 if 引出“If Iroquois white corn had fallen out of production, as it very nearly did two decades ago”，说明主句的条件关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 if 把这一层关系补进去。
